speaker: therapist
text: Good morning Meena garu. Today Asha and I will work on asking for things with two words and on taking turns.

speaker: parent
text: Good morning madam. At home she is saying more words this week.

speaker: therapist
text: Let us start with the snack game. Asha, what do you want?

speaker: therapist
text: Well done Asha, you said want biscuit. In this game she made four two-word requests without any prompt.

speaker: parent
text: At home she still pulls my hand when she wants water.

speaker: therapist
text: Next is the ball rolling game for turn taking. She waited for her turn in six out of ten rolls today, that is sixty percent.

speaker: parent
text: That is better than last month, she used to grab the ball every time.

speaker: therapist
text: Meena garu, when she pulls your hand, wait and model the words want water, then give it when she tries.

speaker: parent
text: Okay madam, I will wait and say want water first.

speaker: therapist
text: For home practice, play the snack game at tea time and roll a ball with her for five minutes each evening.

speaker: therapist
text: Next week we will add colour words to her requests, like red ball and blue cup.

speaker: parent
text: Thank you madam, see you next week.
